description:
Look up an approval request you already created and wait for its outcome.

Use this when a previous request_approval call came back NOT DECIDED YET. Never
call request_approval again for the same action — that asks a second human to
approve something already in front of the first one.

approval_id.description: The id from an earlier request_approval result, such as "apr_7x2k9m".

name: check_approval

approval_id.description: The Quirna id for this request.

authorized.description: True only when the action may proceed. The one field worth branching on.

auto_approved.description: True when a Policy condition did not match and no human was asked.

decided_by.description: User id of the decider, not a name (ZUR-68).

policy.description: Name of the Policy that governed this request.

timeout_at.description: When the request expires if still undecided.

title: Check a pending approval
